'''Matt Farney''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Centerville tournament]] on 16 June 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]], according to Albert Klein's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2463">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-16-centerville-oh-6-16-01d2463/ centerville-oh-6-16-01], DeckTech (AJ "312" Klein, 16 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-16-centerville-oh-6-16-01d2463/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
